name: Update Slack integration mapping
description: Update Slack integration mapping Updates a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack). PUT /2.0/integration_mappings/slack/{integration_mapping_id}
context:
PUT /2.0/integration_mappings/slack/{integration_mapping_id}
Updates a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack). Supports updating the Box folder ID and options. You need Admin or Co-Admin role to use this endpoint.
Required: integration_mapping_id (path) — An ID of an integration mapping.
Optional: body (body) — At least one of `box_item` and `options` must be provided.
